summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the rich repo without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title gated only on is_terminal, returning True when the control is queued and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title) for the title control. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), and test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows-only). Open point: a console that is both a terminal and a dumb terminal returns True but writes nothing, because Console.control() skips dumb terminals; I kept the spec's terminal-only gate.
